plans.name: Kerala Budget Explorer
plans.tagline: Experience Kerala without breaking the bank

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kochi — Colonial Heritage
itinerary.tips: Evening Kathakali show at Kerala Kathakali Centre (₹350) is highly recommended

itinerary.title: Alleppey Backwaters — Day Cruise
itinerary.tips: Book a shared day-cruise boat (₹300-400) instead of a private houseboat to save money

itinerary.title: Thekkady — Wildlife & Spices
itinerary.tips: Bamboo rafting (₹1100) is cheaper than boat safari and more adventurous

itinerary.title: Munnar — Tea Gardens & Hills
itinerary.tips: Rent a two-wheeler (₹400/day) in Munnar to explore viewpoints at your own pace

itinerary.title: Thiruvananthapuram — Capital & Departure
itinerary.tips: Try the famous Kerala Banana Chips and Halwa from Thiruvananthapuram Central market as souvenirs

plans.name: Kerala Family Delight
plans.tagline: Create unforgettable memories with your loved ones
plans.best_for: Families with children, Couples, Group of friends

itinerary.title: Arrive Kochi — Welcome to God's Own Country
places: Sunset at Vasco da Gama Square
itinerary.tips: Kids will love the Chinese fishing net demonstration. Try fresh catch grilled at the nearby stalls

itinerary.title: Kochi Sightseeing & Departure to Alleppey
itinerary.tips: Wonderla is great for children. Book in advance online for discounted tickets

itinerary.title: Alleppey Houseboat — Backwater Magic
itinerary.tips: Children love feeding the ducks and watching fishing. Carry mosquito repellent for evenings

itinerary.title: Thekkady — Elephants & Wildlife
itinerary.tips: Children under 5 need extra care on boat safaris. The elephant interaction program is child-friendly

itinerary.title: Munnar — Tea Hills & Cool Breeze
places: Drive to Munnar through spice gardens
itinerary.tips: Carry warm clothes for Munnar evenings. Kids will enjoy the Nilgiri Tahr (mountain goat) sightings at Eravikulam

itinerary.title: Thiruvananthapuram — Culture & Heritage
itinerary.tips: Dress code strictly enforced at Padmanabhaswamy Temple. Beach dress available to rent near temple

itinerary.title: Kovalam Beach & Departure
itinerary.tips: Buy Kashmiri saffron, Kerala spices, and Kathakali masks as authentic souvenirs

plans.name: Royal Kerala Luxury Journey
plans.best_for: Honeymoon couples, High-end travelers, Special occasions

itinerary.title: Arrive Kochi — Royal Welcome
places: Private airport transfer in luxury vehicle
Check-in at Brunton Boatyard / CGH Fort House
Private heritage walk of Fort Kochi
Sunset dhow cruise on Kochi harbor
itinerary.meals: Welcome gala dinner at The Rice Boat restaurant
itinerary.tips: Request a harbor-facing room for spectacular sunrise views over the Chinese fishing nets

itinerary.title: Kochi — Private Museum & Cooking Class
places: Exclusive Biennale art walk with curator guide
itinerary.meals: All meals including cooking class feast
itinerary.tips: The private cooking class includes a market visit to Kochi's fresh produce market at dawn — absolutely fascinating

itinerary.title: Kumarakom — Luxury Backwaters
itinerary.meals: All meals including houseboat dinner experience
itinerary.tips: Coconut Lagoon is accessible only by boat — the arrival by canoe at dusk is incredibly romantic

itinerary.title: Luxury Houseboat — Day 1
itinerary.meals: All meals — multi-course Kerala cuisine by private chef
itinerary.tips: Request the houseboat captain to navigate to Muhamma for the best bird watching in the early morning

itinerary.title: Luxury Houseboat — Day 2 & Thekkady
places: Evening jungle walk with naturalist guide
itinerary.stay: Spice Village by CGH Earth, Thekkady
itinerary.tips: Request a private guided night trek at Periyar Tiger Reserve — extraordinary wildlife experience

itinerary.title: Thekkady — Bamboo Rafting & Spice Estates
places: Sunrise bamboo rafting on Periyar Lake
Private spice estate tour with plantation owner
itinerary.tips: The private spice estate tour includes a traditional Kerala meal in a plantation bungalow — absolutely authentic

itinerary.title: Munnar — Tea Planters' Experience
places: Drive through Ghat road to Munnar
itinerary.meals: High Tea at tea estate, All meals
itinerary.tips: Arrange a private tea-tasting session with the estate's tea sommelier — extraordinary learning experience

itinerary.title: Kovalam — Ayurveda & Arabian Sea
itinerary.stay: Niraamaya Retreats Surya Samudra (Cliff Heritage Cottage)
itinerary.meals: All meals including private beach candlelit dinner
itinerary.tips: Book the cliff-edge cottage for the most dramatic sea views. The sunset from the private terrace is world-class

itinerary.title: Kovalam & Departure
itinerary.tips: Purchase authentic Kerala handicrafts from the government emporium at MG Road for guaranteed quality and fair prices
